notes:
- Settings previews now show the real choices: Interface settings preview the bottom bar lift with spring motion, the new library views, the expanded Home sequel styles and the cover-only card style. First-run setup now recommends the New look, System theme, normal jokes and catalogue search while keeping every choice editable.
- Library and Home have more ways to browse: the Library adds Big cards and Shelf views, and Home adds Banners and Shelf cards for missed sequels.
- Info actions fit narrow screens: AniList and Add to Planning stack into full-width controls when the title page is narrow, preventing the planning button's label and confirmation face from being clipped beside the external link.
- Info pages fit edge-to-edge screens: The title banner stays full-bleed while hero actions, the docked capsule and the appearance editor clear cutouts in immersive mode. The list no longer consumes the navigation inset twice, so the last card and bottom controls stop at the right place.
- Golden jokes are opt-in and unmistakable: A toggleable one-in-a-thousand golden draw adds intentionally harsh lines behind a clear warning. Golden toasts use a gold Material surface, a vector star and a longer dwell, while ordinary jokes keep their existing tone filters and shuffle bag.
- Jokes, greetings and reveals have more range: The dark-joke and welcome pools are larger, text effects restart cleanly when their mode changes, and the toast renderer now lives separately from its scheduling logic so a replacement line cannot inherit stale reveal state.
- Font imports show their work: Font loading now uses the Material 3 Expressive indicator with animated loading and error surfaces, and a cancelled import releases the disabled state instead of leaving the picker stuck.
- Cover colours choose stable accents: Equal-scoring cover colour bins now resolve deterministically instead of depending on histogram iteration order, so the same artwork keeps the same Material 3 accent after a restart.
